title: Delivery-automation failure and prevention registry
purpose: Records authoritative delivery-automation failures and durable prevention evidence without granting autonomous governance authority.

historical_gaps.reason: No authoritative repository evidence was found during the #617 readiness audit.

records.title: PR-body validation parity
records.failure_pattern: Local, CI, and live PR-body validation disagreed for equivalent published evidence.
records.prevention_summary: Canonical normalization, one production validation path, canonical changed scope, unresolved-instruction detection, and local/CI/live parity.

records.title: PR-body transport and persistence integrity
records.failure_pattern: PR-body Unicode transport or persistence representations corrupted content or caused a premature permanent-mismatch classification.
records.prevention_summary: Exact UTF-8 body-only payloads, immutable preconditions, a zero-or-one PATCH budget, bounded read-only stabilization, typed outcomes, and post-persistence validation without retry or rollback.

records.title: Unexpected issue closure through development linkage
records.failure_pattern: GitHub development linkage closed a parent or continuation issue after a bounded PR merge although PR-body wording did not state that the issue was resolved.
records.prevention_summary: Future prevention must inspect all issue-closing mechanisms, bind closure authority to exact issue numbers, verify post-merge issue states, and record the closure source.
remaining_work: Implement read-only closure-linkage inspection and its regression coverage in a later #617 slice.
Do not infer closure safety solely from PR-body wording or implement a merge controller in this slice.

privacy_and_evidence_limits: Store public issue and pull-request identifiers, repository-relative paths, and concise evidence summaries only.
Do not store credentials, authorization headers, environment contents, private hosts, full PR bodies, or private evidence payloads.
